candidate: EdgeConneX Fyresdal data center campus, Molandsmoen, Fyresdal (Vestfold og Telemark), Norway: permit-named property gbnr. 38/133-134 (municipality 4032)
decision: Selected the centroid of the union of the two cadastral parcels (teiger) that Fyresdal municipality's framework permit of 14 August 2025 (ref. 2025/183-21, delegated decision 147/25) names as the data-centre property, gbnr. 38/133-134, as the campus locator. The six data halls are not separately located.
coordinate_reference_system: Source parcels from Kartverket's WFS Matrikkelen - Eiendomskart Teig, requested in EPSG:25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N); union and centroid computed in EPSG:25832 with shapely 2.1.1, then transformed to EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude with pyproj 3.7.1 (always_xy=True). ETRS89 and WGS84 are treated as coincident at this scale (pyproj's default transformation); no further datum shift is applied.

source_selection: Fyresdal municipality's framework permit letter of 14 August 2025 (Rammeløyve - Molandsmoen gbnr 38/133-134, Fyresdal; property/address Birtedalsvegen 57) and its news item of 29 September 2025 name gbnr. 38/133-134 as the property for EdgeConnex MCN Norway AS's data-centre development (six data halls, access building, two water towers, internal roads, technical installations) within zone KBA_1 of the zoning plan 'Molandsmoen industri og friluftsområde' (plan id 38230001). Both parcels were requested in one WFS GetFeature call filtered on kommunenummer 4032 and matrikkelnummerTekst 38/133 or 38/134; each was also captured separately (geonorge-teig-fyresdal-38-133.gml, geonorge-teig-fyresdal-38-134.gml) with identical geometry.

checks.check: official address of the permit property
checks.result: Kartverket's address register places Birtedalsvegen 57 (address id 6493745948, registered on matrikkel unit 38/134, record updated 2025-08-13) at 59.201846 N, 8.074649 E, inside the union and 186.8 m (GRS80 geodesic) from the centroid.

A bounding-box query of Kartverket's Matrikkelen - Bygningspunkt WFS (59.198-59.212 N, 8.055-8.095 E; local geonorge-bygningspunkt-molandsmoen-bbox4258.gml) returns no building on 38/133-134, so no building point is available; the existing Molandsmoen industrial estate (street Molandsmoen, gbnr. 38/40-38/125) lies east of the parcels and is not used.
The point is the centroid of the two permit-named data-centre parcels only, not of the Molandsmoen industrial and recreation zoning plan or the industrial estate.
